display.title: Magic Stat 4.5.1 is here — and a note for you
display.subtitle: For a limited time, the full annual license is US$ 99 (normally US$ 990 a year).
display.message: Magic Stat normally costs US$ 990 a year. Many researchers around the world loved it — and wrote to us asking for an easier way to bring a colleague, a student, a whole lab on board. We listened: for a limited time, the full annual license is US$ 99. Everyone is welcome. The offer is already live on our site (getmagicstat.com) and at checkout — there is no coupon code to enter.
highlights: A lighter Magic Stat: about 25% smaller than the previous build (roughly 145 MB)
Looping Plots and Combine Plots — many figures at once, several charts on one page
Every analysis lands in the Analysis Report, with tables and figures
